# MagpieCSS/CMS - LLM Context & Repository Map

MagpieCSS/CMS is a modern, lightweight, themeable vanilla design system and components framework. Originally extracted from administrative tools (MagpieStash) and wiki platforms (MagpieNest), it is built specifically for data-dense user interfaces, document libraries, and native LLM content negotiation (serving styled HTML to humans and token-efficient Markdown to AI agents).

This file provides a structured interface map of the repository's stylesheets, component classes, design tokens, and JavaScript APIs to help AI agents read, write, and maintain the codebase.

---

## 1. Directory & File Map

- [index.html](file:///c:/magpieCss/index.html): Interactive showcase website, components sandbox, and design system documentation.
- [showcase.css](file:///c:/magpieCss/showcase.css): Layout styles and modifications specific to the showcase site page.
- [showcase.js](file:///c:/magpieCss/showcase.js): Local page controller, theme switching event listeners, and interactive UI demo bindings.
- [changelog.json](file:///c:/magpieCss/changelog.json): Release entries and framework feature history.
- [build.js](file:///c:/magpieCss/build.js): Bundles and minifies stylesheets and scripts from `src/` to `dist/`.
- [dist/](file:///c:/magpieCss/dist/): Compiled production assets:
  - `dist/magpie.css`: Bundled stylesheet (variables, resets, layout, components, icon classes).
  - `dist/magpie.min.css`: Minified bundled stylesheet.
  - `dist/magpie.js`: Main framework JavaScript helpers.
  - `dist/magpie.min.js`: Minified framework JavaScript helpers.
- [src/](file:///c:/magpieCss/src/): Source stylesheets before bundling:
  - `src/variables.css`: Core design tokens and CSS properties for all themes.
  - `src/reset.css`: Global base styles and browser normalization.
  - `src/layout.css`: Sidebar desktop grid, printing media queries, and responsive layouts.
  - `src/components.css`: Buttons, cards, modals, tables, collapsible trees, and alert widgets.
  - `src/icons.css`: Generated CSS mask-image classes for all SVG icons.

---

## 2. Design Tokens (CSS Variables)

Colors, spacing, and speeds are defined globally in `src/variables.css` under the `:root` element. Themes are toggled by setting the `data-theme` attribute (values: `magpie`, `dark`, `light`, `hc`, `terminal`) on the `<html>` or `<body>` element.

### Core Semantic Variables
- `--bg`: Global page viewport background color.
- `--card`: Panel/card container background color.
- `--text`: Main text color (high contrast against `--bg`).
- `--muted-text`: Subtitles, hints, and secondary text color.
- `--border`: Standard border color for separators and input outlines.
- `--accent`: Primary interaction color (blue theme default).
- `--secondary`: Auxiliary highlights (teal theme default).
- `--danger`: Error alert borders and red action buttons.
- `--gold`: Special highlighted state badges (gold theme default).

---

## 3. UI Component Class Map

Use these semantic classes to structure HTML layouts that remain cleanly readable by both humans and LLMs:

### Layout Structures
- `.app-layout`: Main structural parent. Uses CSS grid for sidebar and main content frame.
- `.app-logo`: Container for the logo emblem and branding.
- `.app-nav`: Sidebar navigation pane enclosing link elements.
- `.app-content`: Main content frame where document sections are rendered.
- `.doc-section`: Standard section page wrapper.
- `.doc-section-title`: Heading for page sections (contains an inline SVG and text).
- `.doc-subsection-title`: Subheading for component variants.
- `.component-demo`: Styled box enclosing interactive UI demos.

### Standalone Widgets
- `.stash-btn`: Primary solid action button.
- `.stash-btn-outline`: Secondary outlined action button.
- `.card-container`: Parent container for 3D flipping cards.
- `.card-3d`: Intersecting child managing 3D perspective rotates.
- `.card-front` / `.card-back`: Double-sided card faces.
- `.wiki-content-body`: Wrapper for rendering markdown typography (blockquote, lists, standard headings).
- `.locations-container`: Root container for tree hierarchies.
- `.tree-branch`: Structural branch connecting child tree-nodes.
- `.tree-node`: Parent collapsible details block.
- `.node-header`: Summary tag wrapping node toggle indicators and name.
- `.code-block`: Structured code wrapper with lang badges and copy actions.
- `.modal-overlay`: Full-screen overlay background container.
- `.modal-content`: Centered dialog container inside overlay.
- `.m-icon`: Base class for SVG masks.
- `.m-icon-[name]`: Specific mask image utility for any of the 51 icons (e.g. `m-icon-home`, `m-icon-settings`).

---

## 4. Client-Side JavaScript API (`window.MagpieCSS`)

The client library in `dist/magpie.js` manages stateful interactions and notifies listeners:

### Theme Manager (`MagpieCSS.theme`)
- `MagpieCSS.theme.set(themeName)`: Swaps the active visual theme (`magpie`, `dark`, `light`, `hc`, `terminal`).
- `MagpieCSS.theme.init()`: Loads and applies the user's saved theme preference from `localStorage`.

### Toast System (`MagpieCSS.toast`)
- `MagpieCSS.toast.show(message, type, duration)`: Triggers a dynamic banner notification (`type` values: `success`, `warning`, `error`).
- `MagpieCSS.toast.showClippy(title, message, duration, actionCallback, customIconHtml)`: Triggers an interactive magpie assistant overlay notification with custom callback triggers.

### Custom Dialog Modals (`MagpieCSS.dialog`)
- `MagpieCSS.dialog.alert(message, title)`: Opens a clean modal dialog with an OK button. Returns a Promise.
- `MagpieCSS.dialog.confirm(message, title)`: Opens a confirm/cancel dialog. Returns a Promise resolving to `true` or `false`.

### CMS DOM-to-Markdown Compiler (`MagpieCSS.cms`)
- `MagpieCSS.cms.toMarkdown(element)`: Recursively parses a MagpieCSS DOM subtree and compiles it into clean, token-efficient Markdown, stripping out utility design clutter for LLM crawlers.
